description: This file defines the 'Compact' formatter class for SCSS PHP compiler, which formats CSS output in a compact style. It inherits from a base Formatter class and overrides certain properties and methods to produce minimized CSS with specific formatting behavior, though it's deprecated in favor of a 'Compressed' formatter.

classes.name: ScssPhp\ScssPhp\Formatter\Compact
classes.description: A formatter class that outputs CSS in a compact style, inheriting from the base Formatter class. It is marked as deprecated since version 1.4.0.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with specific formatting options and triggers a deprecation warning indicating that this formatter is deprecated in favor of the 'Compressed' formatter.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the string used for indentation, which is a single space character.
